---

precentor of Salisbury Cathedral

Son of the Rev.

Gilbert Heathcote, Vicar of Hursley;  he was precentor of Salisbury Cathedral till his death; he wrote hymns; he was Warden of Radley College 1852-3;  he married (1852) Elizabeth Mary Deane.
